_comment: Config for the OFFLINE entity-extraction eval harness (tools/eval_entities.py).
This file is deliberately SEPARATE from pipeline-config.json and is NOT yet read
by the Gradle codegen or check_shared_sync.py: nothing in the app extracts
entities on its own path today, so there is no Kotlin side to keep in sync and
adding one now would only add build coupling for a prompt that has not passed
its quality gate. When the backfill actually ships, fold these keys into the
codegen the same way clustering's are, and add them to check_shared_sync.py.
Until then: change values here, re-run the harness, read the report.
TOKEN BUDGET MATHS (Groq free tier pre-counts input + max_completion_tokens
against a hard 8000 TPM cap, so every call must RESERVE its worst case):
completion  = completionBase + completionPerItem * batchSize, clamped so that
-> 8000 / 2770 = ~2.9 calls per rolling 60s window (~21s effective spacing)
tpmBudget is held under the 8000 hard cap so a mis-estimate does not 429.
